# Nekkos

> Open-source, local-first AI chat, cowork, and coding in one calm window. Nekkos' headline feature is **first-class local model support**: point it at Ollama, LM Studio, or vLLM in one click, alongside every major cloud provider. Desktop, self-hosted web, and Docker editions run the same engine and the same UI. MIT licensed, by Nekko Labs.

Local model UIs are essentially a chat box around a model with no awareness of your files or projects. Terminal agents are powerful but blind. Nekkos sits in between: an IDE-like surface where the agent reads, edits, searches, and runs inside your actual codebases, with every action visible through a context-provenance inspector and approval prompts.

## Key facts

- **What it is**: a local-first AI coding and cowork app (Electron + React) that unifies conversation and coding into one surface.
- **Local models first**: one-click setup for Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM, plus every major cloud provider. Verified end-to-end against a live LM Studio server, including reasoning models and the full multi-step tool-calling agent loop.
- **Editions** (same engine, same UI, different transport): **Desktop** (macOS, Windows, Linux) available; **self-hosted web** (`npx nekkos` or `npm run web`, fully offline) available; **Docker** (`docker compose up`, workspaces as volumes) available; **phone remote control** (pair by QR, end-to-end encrypted, managed relay free in beta or self-host it) available; **Nekkos Cloud** (paid, hosted, always-on Zero-Data-Retention mode, cloud history and files) planned.
- **Privacy**: local-first. Inference and tools stay on your machine, data lives in `~/.nekkos`. Nekkos Cloud's relay is an end-to-end-encrypted pipe to your own paired agent, so driving a local model from your phone stays private by design.
- **Licence**: MIT, open source, developed in the open with contributions welcome.

## Features

- **Unified chat / cowork / code** in one window, no mode switching.
- **Context inspector**: provenance for everything the model was shown, so you can see why it answered the way it did.
- **Guardrails by default**: risky commands need approval.
- **Sandbox out of the box**: configurable sandbox modes for tool execution.
- **Multi-folder index**: browse the indexed tree, view files and diffs, edit inline.
- **Memory management**: per-project memory you can inspect and edit.
- **Connectors** and MCP support, including [Hypergate](https://hypergate.app) as an MCP gateway.
- **Nekkos**, an 8-bit cat mascot that makes biscuits while the model thinks.

## Install

Grab the installer for your OS from the [latest release](https://github.com/nekko-labs/nekkos/releases/latest): Windows `.msi`/`.exe`, macOS `.dmg`, Linux `.AppImage`/`.deb`. macOS builds are not notarized yet, so clear the quarantine flag once with `xattr -cr "/Applications/Nekkos.app"` after installing.
